text:
anya: Heads-up — bringing up q8b-int4 today. Want a quick smoke on the prompt bank before wider canary.
sam: SGTM. Target longform summaries, instruction-following, code blocks, and top-20 live intents.
lee: I can sample ~1.5k stratified by (intent, length). Plan: exact-token dedupe, then fuzzy 95%+ cluster collapse. Keep near-dupes separate.
anya: Good. Keep near-duplicate audit for later.
maria: Create a temporary campaign so reviewers know this is regression-only? q8b-int4-smoke-regress?
labeler-ops-bot: @maria created campaign q8b-int4-smoke-regress (1500 tasks) -> group "smoke-reviewers"; ETA=48h.
sam: Attach per-sample metadata: sample_id,prompt_hash,intent,length_bucket,model_variant,quant_profile,decode_params,seed,baseline_model.
lee: CSV header and initial 600 rows uploaded to s3://redwood-qa/q8b-int4/initial_batch.csv
anya: Add an auto-prefilter: token-overlap vs franklin-fp16 baseline and BLEU delta. Flag overlap_ratio < 0.7 or BLEU_drop > 0.12. Tag reason.
sam: Quick pseudo:
```
overlap = tok_overlap(baseline, q8b)
if overlap / baseline_tokens < 0.7:
    flag(sample_id, "low_overlap")
```
maria: First 300 edgecases -> senior reviewers only. Label form: severity (none/minor/major/critical), regression_type (hallucination/omission/formatting/code-safety), notes.
anya: Decision rule: if instruction-accuracy drops >5% OR any critical hallucination OR code-safety flags spike -> pause rollout. Post short updates in this thread only.
